user_visible_package.prompt: You are the on-call KFC UK & Ireland public-channel publisher on 17 February 2018. Draft a same-day customer update about the fresh-chicken delivery disruption and a short internal request for the operational details needed for the next customer update. Decide how to handle individual-restaurant availability when no restaurant-level status source or approved customer-check route has been supplied.
user_visible_package.acting_role: on-call KFC UK & Ireland public-channel publisher on 17 February 2018
material_facts: A disruption involving the new delivery partner is making it difficult to get fresh chicken to KFC's 900 restaurants; 900 is delivery scope, not a count of affected restaurants.
KFC will not compromise its fresh-chicken quality standard.
Some restaurants are closed, operating limited menus, or on shortened hours, and unspecified teams are working to restore operations.
Individual restaurant states, affected count, geography, duration, recovery timing, named recovery owner, and approved customer-check route are not established.

decision_record.consequential_decision: Publish a truthful same-day update while preserving the unresolved status of each individual restaurant.
decision_record.decision_owner_authority: The public-channel publisher owns this update; the named operational recovery owner is unknown.
decision_record.objective_material_consequence: An invented restaurant status, affected count, recovery time, or customer-check route could misdirect customers.

evidence_state_ledger.proposition: Delivery scope covers 900 restaurants, while individual restaurant impact and current status remain unestablished.
evidence_state_ledger.provenance_authority: KFC UK & Ireland first-party operational update

must.contract_clause: Identify the new-delivery-partner disruption and preserve 900 restaurants as delivery scope rather than affected count.
State that KFC will not compromise its fresh-chicken quality standard.
Communicate that some restaurants are closed, on limited menus, or on shortened hours.
Make clear that the update does not establish any individual restaurant's current state.
State only that unspecified teams are restoring operations, without inventing a named owner or timeline.
Request restaurant-level status, coverage, menu or hours constraints, effective time, next-update timing, and any approved owner or customer-check method.

must_not.contract_clause: Do not turn 900 into an impact count or invent affected counts, duration, or recovery timing.
Do not invent an individual status, geography, status page, contact route, or operational process.
Do not name an unsupported owner, claim progress or outcomes, or relax the quality standard.

oracle.pass_sufficiency_rule: Pass when the update conveys the supported disruption, quality constraint, and possible operating impacts while preserving individual-status uncertainty, and the handoff requests the concrete time-sensitive details required for a later update.
consequential_disqualifying_errors: Treating all 900 restaurants as closed or affected.
Inventing any restaurant, count, geography, duration, recovery, owner, or customer-check mechanism.
Claiming later outcomes or proposing a quality exception.

underspecification.two_world_witness: An intended restaurant may be operating normally or may be closed or constrained; the supplied facts cannot distinguish those states, so individual-status guidance must remain bounded.

validity_docket.fluent_wrong_anchor: All 900 restaurants are closed but will reopen shortly; check our live location page for yours.
validity_docket.noncanonical_good_anchor: Explain the delivery difficulty and possible closures, reduced menus, or hours; preserve the quality standard and individual-status uncertainty; then request time-stamped operational detail and any approved customer-check route.
validity_docket.rationale: The first-party operational update supports a bounded same-day communication oracle without later creative or outcome knowledge.

transformation_redaction_log: Retained reported metrics and prospect-feedback mechanism.
Excluded later expectations and unspecified feature details.

user_visible_package.prompt: You are Michael Kaiser-Nyman, CEO and founder of Impact Dialing, at the end of a two-week PPC test. Prepare a one-page decision memo for company leadership describing what to do next with the tested acquisition effort and near-term product priorities, plus a compact measurement follow-up.
material_facts: Feature feasibility and segment value are unknown.

decision_record.consequential_decision: Continue, pause, or stop commercial PPC and allocate the next budget.
decision_record.decision_owner_authority: CEO and founder controls campaign and product priorities.
decision_record.objective_material_consequence: Continued spend may fund an uninterpretable or product-constrained acquisition path.

evidence_state_ledger.proposition: Commercial prospects report missing capabilities while paid conversion is extremely low.
evidence_state_ledger.provenance_authority: named founder interview and campaign metrics

must.contract_clause: Recommend a bounded acquisition next step from the observed economics and feedback.
Distinguish measured observations from causal or market conclusions.
Address product priorities without assuming requested capability value or feasibility.
Include a compact list of evidence needed before more spend or product commitment.

must_not.contract_clause: Do not turn one constrained test into a universal channel claim.
Do not invent economics, feature details, or causal isolation.
Do not turn the test into a universal PPC, political-market, or product conclusion.

may.contract_clause: Several bounded next allocations are valid.

oracle.pass_sufficiency_rule: The memo must bound acquisition, separate observations from conclusions, gate product priorities, and specify measurement before more spend or commitment.

underspecification.two_world_witness: Cheap common capabilities support build-and-retest; costly heterogeneous requests support stopping. A common bounded policy is to pause broad spend and discriminate.

validity_docket.fluent_wrong_anchor: Optimize bids and scale because traffic quality is the only issue.
validity_docket.noncanonical_good_anchor: Stop media spend and continue low-cost buyer discovery until one capability is shown common and feasible.
validity_docket.rationale: The specific named incident yields a bounded T3 policy without importing its later outcome.
